admin-email.message: Set the administrator's email address: open a Terminal for this app and run /app/code/set-admin-email.sh you@example.com. It renames the existing account; do not change the address any other way.

admin-password.message: Read the administrator password from /app/data/.secrets/env (DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD) with the File Manager or Terminal, then sign in.

models.message: The local extraction and embedding models download on first use, not at install: about 784 MB (GLiNER) and 67 MB (fastembed) into /app/models. The first cognify is slow while they download.

language-model.message: Optional: point Cognee at a language model (LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY) for richer extraction; without one it extracts with the local GLiNER model. See POSTINSTALL.md.
